DevelopmentDescription: Planning permission for a new office building and data centre within the existing facility.  The proposed development includes the construction of a 4 storey office building with an elevated atrium, a screened roof top plant area and roof top satellite dishes; a single storey data centre building with rooftop plant/air handling units; a 4 storey multi-storey car park with bicycle storage, dry room and staff locker rooms; the addition of a single storey deck to an existing car park; and all associated landscaping, fencing, signage and site development works.
